You see the stock market fall and think: “Money must be seeking refuge in gold.”
You look at gold. It’s falling too.
“Well, then, into Bitcoin.”
Bitcoin crashes.
You look at oil. Same story.
And then the question arises:
Where is the money going? ..

If you told me years ago I'd be on Capitol Hill fighting to change legislation, I never would have believed you ..❤️‍.. This week I was back in D.C. for the DEFIANCE Act. The Senate passed it unanimously. Now the House needs to act. Call your representatives ❤️‍..
